newsitem.title: THAILAND: BEC World buys 20 pct stake in CVD Entertainment.
newsitem.headline: BEC World buys 20 pct stake in CVD Entertainment.

text.p: Media firm and broadcaster BEC World will buy a 20 percent stake costing 324 million baht ($11.37 million) in CVD Entertainment Plc, BEC World said in statement on Wednesday.

BEC will buy 1.2 million existing CVD shares at 45 baht per share and six million new shares at the same price, the statement said. After the deal, CVD's registered capital will rise to 360 from 300 million baht. The new share issue is scheduled for August.

CVD, a music and video distributor, will use 50 million baht to fund subsidiary Media Link Co Ltd, 70 million baht as working capital and an unspecified amount to help service 150 million baht in debts, a company statement said.
CVD's shares were unchanged at 50 baht shortly after opening, BEC World shares also unchanged at 254 baht by 0306 GMT. The overall market dropped 8.26 points, or 1.34 percent, to 605.93.
